events.title: The Hotel Carnivalia Steam page is live
events.summary: Hey everyone. We're DARELARK Studio, the team making Hotel Carnivalia.Our Steam store page is finally live. Getting the build out of our office and onto this page took way longer than we thought it would. It feels great to finally put the name and the screenshots out there and actually talk about them.So what is itHotel Carnivalia is a 15 player first person social deduction game.
